dgm.text: In Bane Alley, Bartek gives Andra an ornament as a gift, and she sells him a dark dagger for five zinos, leaving him with one zino.
The next morning Bartek arrives bruised, having been jumped on his way to work and robbed of the dagger.

Andra writes a coded report saying the item is now with a third party, revealing she works for House Dimir and sold the dagger twice, and she explains her trick of selling an illicit item and arranging for it to be stolen, having asked the buyer to leave Bartek alive.
